question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I am going to take you for a ________ up there.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ride."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sentence refers to taking someone somewhere, which requires a verb that implies movement.**
 
• The words "Rite" and "write" are both incorrect, as they are not related to transportation.
 
• "Right" could be a possible option, but it doesn't convey the idea of movement as clearly as "ride".
 
• **"Ride" means used to describe what a journey or trip is like. (**आरोहण करना)
 
 
• Example: Its only a short bus ride to Delhi.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct sentence is "I am going to take you for a **ride__** up there."

Hence, the **correct answer is option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Rite", refers to a religious or ceremonial practice. (संस्कार)
 
• "Write", means to put words on paper or another medium. (लिखना)
 
• "Right" means correct or straight. (सही)
